SELECT [t0].[ProjectId], [t0].[TicketStatus], [t0].[Bucket], COUNT(*) AS [Count]
FROM (
    SELECT [t].[ProjectId], [t].[TicketStatus], CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF(hour, [t].[CreatedDate], @asOf) < 24 THEN 0
        WHEN DATEDIFF(hour, [t].[CreatedDate], @asOf) < 168 THEN 1
        WHEN DATEDIFF(hour, [t].[CreatedDate], @asOf) < 720 THEN 2
        WHEN DATEDIFF(hour, [t].[CreatedDate], @asOf) < 2160 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END AS [Bucket]
    FROM [dbo].[Tickets] AS [t]
    WHERE [t].[TicketStatus] <> 3
) AS [t0]
GROUP BY [t0].[ProjectId], [t0].[TicketStatus], [t0].[Bucket]

SELECT COUNT(*)

WHERE [t].[TicketStatus] <> 3 AND [t].[AssignedTo] IS NULL

SELECT TOP(@p) [t].[AssignedTo], COUNT(CASE
    WHEN [t].[TicketStatus] = 0 THEN 1
END) AS [Active], COUNT(CASE
    WHEN [t].[TicketStatus] = 1 THEN 1
END) AS [MoreInfo], COUNT(CASE
    WHEN [t].[TicketStatus] = 2 THEN 1
END) AS [Resolved], COUNT(*) AS [Open], MIN([t].[CreatedDate]) AS [Oldest], AVG([s].[value]) AS [AvgHours], MAX([s0].[value]) AS [MaxHours]
FROM [dbo].[Tickets] AS [t]
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT CAST(DATEDIFF(hour, COALESCE((
        SELECT MAX([t0].[EventDate])
        FROM [dbo].[TicketEvents] AS [t0]
        WHERE [t].[TicketId] = [t0].[TicketId] AND ([t0].[ForActivity] & 464 <> 0 OR ([t0].[ForActivity] & 1024 <> 0 AND [t0].[EventBy] = [t].[AssignedTo]))), [t].[CreatedDate]), @asOf) AS float) AS [value]
) AS [s]
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT DATEDIFF(hour, COALESCE((
        SELECT MAX([t1].[EventDate])
        FROM [dbo].[TicketEvents] AS [t1]
        WHERE [t].[TicketId] = [t1].[TicketId] AND ([t1].[ForActivity] & 464 <> 0 OR ([t1].[ForActivity] & 1024 <> 0 AND [t1].[EventBy] = [t].[AssignedTo]))), [t].[CreatedDate]), @asOf) AS [value]
) AS [s0]
WHERE [t].[TicketStatus] <> 3 AND [t].[AssignedTo] IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY [t].[AssignedTo]
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, [t].[AssignedTo]
